name: NANDY ASIJA
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Hi, I am an experienced AOD and mental health counsellor with over 7 years of industry experience in different sectors. I have conducted group therapy and also worked one-on-one with individual clients from varying backgrounds including family violence, complex needs, bereavement, grief & profound loss, anxiety issues and complex mental health issues. My empathetic and non-judgemental approach caters to clients from varying multi-cultural background, age, gender and race.

name: Kamila Schneltser
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: At the heart of my private practice is the commitment to fostering a therapeutic space where you can safely navigate through personal challenges, such as depression, grief, intimacy-related issues, self-esteem, creative blockages, and relationship issues. My approach integrates a rich tapestry of therapeutic modalities through a strength-based approach weaving in symbolic work, Eastern practices, nature-based therapy, and psychodynamic therapy tailored to empower you on your journey toward healing. Taking the first step to seeking a more fulfilling and happier life takes courage.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Barbara Churcher
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder.

name: Marie Bourke
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I work Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays at Josephs Corner Yarraville, a not for profit free counselling service for those affected by family members or friends in addiction. Our service is offered face to face or telehealth, whatever works for you. There are many programs available for those in addiction but few for those who support or live closely with them, and it is stressful and wearing.

name: Jane Hall
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Counselling and psychotherapist working with people experiencing anxiety and depression, stress management, trauma, life transitions, grief and loss. I offer Internal Family Systems Therapy (IFS) informed counselling and also mindfulness and meditation, personal growth and development, life meaning, purpose and spirituality; energy based psychotherapy and Therapeutic Touch.

name: Rebeka Harriott
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Jungian Analyst and Pychotherapist.

name: Emma van Daal
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Experience in trauma, disordered eating (arts therapy, Domestic/family violence, and infant/early childhood mental health. Clinical supervision in the area of infant, child, and family mental health, and arts therapy. Secondary consultation and debriefing available for therapists subject to a Family Circuit Court or Children's Court of Victoria subpoena.

name: Julie Jensen
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: PACFA Registered Clinical Counsellor · Registered Clinical Psychotherapist · Mental Health Practitioner I am an experienced counsellor, Gestalt psychotherapist and thanatologist specialising in grief across dying, death, bereavement and non-death losses. I also support people living with situational or chronic disorganisation and hoarding. I provide neurodiversity-affirming support for ADHD, autism and other brain-based conditions such as anxiety, depression, stress and burnout.
